phases.name: takeoff_propulsion
phases.definition: Final ground-supported propulsion interval ending at the first frame with no supporting foot contact.

phases.name: rotation_flight_adjustment
phases.definition: From the first frame with no supporting foot contact through the frame immediately before first landing contact.

phases.name: landing_impact_absorption
phases.definition: From first landing contact through the collection producer's audited end of primary impact absorption.

phases.name: post_landing_balance
phases.definition: From the first frame after primary impact absorption through clip completion while recovering stable support.
